definitions.fibre: AOAC fibre (includes resistant starch and lignin), the method used for UK fibre recommendations
definitions.vitaminA: Retinol equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene equivalents / 6 (the UK definition; US values are retinol activity equivalents)
definitions.vitaminD: Total vitamin D; for meat, cholecalciferol + 5 x 25-hydroxy vitamin D3 where known
definitions.niacinNE: Niacin equivalents as published by CoFID (niacin + tryptophan/60)
definitions.la: cis n-6 C18:2 per 100 g food
definitions.ala: cis n-3 C18:3 per 100 g food
definitions.epa: cis n-3 C20:5 per 100 g food; where CoFID gives only total C20:5, that value is used and labelled
